capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Upload-on-save, download-on-open, and running remote commands read behavior straight out of the workspace's sftp.json and are disabled until the workspace is trusted. Manually triggered commands (Upload File, Download Project, etc.) still work.

configuration.title: sftp configuration
configuration.sftp.debug.description: Print debug output to the sftp output channel. (reload VS Code when you change this)
configuration.sftp.printDebugLog.descrip: Deprecated alias for sftp.debug. Use sftp.debug instead.
configuration.sftp.printDebugLog.depreca: Deprecated: use sftp.debug instead. This setting is still honored for backward compatibility.
configuration.sftp.printDebugLog.markdow: **Deprecated** — use `#sftp.debug#` instead. This setting is still honored for backward compatibility.
configuration.sftp.downloadWhenOpenInRem: Opening a file in the Remote Explorer runs "Edit in Local" (download into the workspace) instead of editing it on the server.
configuration.sftp.openRemoteFilesReadOn: Open files from the Remote Explorer read-only, so they can't be saved straight to the server. Applies to files opened after the change.
walkthrough.sftpresso.gettingStarted.des: Connect a local folder to a remote server over SFTP/FTP and sync your changes on save.
walkthrough.sftpresso.gettingStarted.cre:
Run **SFTP: Config** and pick Quick setup to write a `.vscode/sftp.json` for your server.
[Run SFTP: Config](command:sftp.config)
walkthrough.sftpresso.gettingStarted.tes:
Run **SFTP: Test Connection** to confirm SFTPresso can reach your server before syncing files.
[Run SFTP: Test Connection](command:sftp.testConnection)
walkthrough.sftpresso.gettingStarted.dow:
Starting from an existing remote project? Run **SFTP: Download Project** to pull it into your folder.
[Run SFTP: Download Project](command:sftp.download.project)
walkthrough.sftpresso.gettingStarted.upl:
Run **SFTP: Toggle Upload on Save** so every save mirrors to the remote automatically.
[Run SFTP: Toggle Upload on Save](command:sftp.toggleUploadOnSave)
